meta.encoding: hex unless the field name says otherwise; *Base64/*B64 are standard base64 with padding
meta.authoredBy: @blocknote/server-util blocksToYXmlFragment, the path desktop main calls
meta.notClaimed: this is not markdown and not a rendering; it is the block list a shell draws from
